tagline: Wireless Systems • Signal Processing • Machine Learning • Intelligent Sensing
summary: PhD in Electrical and Computer Engineering (University of Oklahoma, 2025) with undergraduate teaching in Computer Programming, Communication Systems and Wireless Communication. Research on reliable AI/ML for wireless networks includes propagation prediction, generative augmentation, transfer learning, outage detection and network self-healing. Related work in wearable sensing and time-series modeling. Engineering R&D at AT&T Labs, Futurewei and AT&T, alongside student mentoring and communications laboratory instruction.
